raw_segments.text: It is well known how the monks wrote silly lives of Catholic Saints over the manuscripts on which the classical works of ancient heathendom had been written.
The German literati reversed this process with the profane French literature. They wrote their philosophical nonsense beneath the French original.
For instance, beneath the French criticism of the economic functions of money, they wrote
Alienation of Humanity, and beneath the French criticism of the bourgeois State they wrote
Dethronement of the Category of the General, and so forth.
